title: Deleted, with Undo
note: After the confirm, the letter moves to Recently deleted for 30 days. The screen says so and Undo stays until the person taps Undo, Close or Back (no timer).
text: Letter deleted. It waits in Recently deleted for 30 days. Undo it now, or close to go back to the book. Letter deleted. Undo
